verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of USPS Form 1583, notarization, ID requirements, or any guided identity-verification workflow — it only covers mail forwarding, virtual addresses, and mail-center operator features. This is a fair and common axis for a virtual mailbox/CMRA product (Form 1583 is core to activating such a service), but no evidence shows Anytime Mailbox provides pre-filled forms, online notarization, or ID guidance.
